title: Annotatio III §.X open: Whatever of the Form — Transsubstantiation unworthy of Christ’s banquet; eliminate it
pass_a_gloss: §. X. Whatever meanwhile be made of the Form of pontifical Transsubstantiation, affixed rashly enough and without all authority of Holy Scripture to the pronunciation of either four or five words; Transsubstantiation itself, especially conceived and taken in its whole ambit, is utterly unworthy of the Sacred Banquet instituted by Christ, and most worthy indeed to be eliminated from the whole Church of Christ.
pass_b_english: §.X: leave the four- or five-word Form fight — rashly pinned on without Scripture’s authority.
Transsubstantiation itself, taken in full scope, is utterly unworthy of Christ’s instituted banquet and most worthy to be wiped from Christ’s whole Church.
source_text: §. X. Quicquid interim de Pontificiæ Transsubstantiationis Forma, sive quatuor, sive quinque verborum pronuntiationi, temerè satis & citra omnem Scripturæ S. authoritatem, affixa, fiat; Ipsa certè Transsubstantiatio, præsertim in omni suo ambitu concepta acceptaque, Sacro à Christo instituto Epulo prorsus indigna, dignissima verò est, quæ Ecclesiâ Christi totâ eliminetur.

lemmas.gloss: be eliminated from Christ’s whole Church
